propositions: Allowlisted read-only tool calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) are memoized at the shared agent-call seam to prevent duplicate re-execution within a single run, with the wrapped tool executing exactly once for N identical calls
Deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' are memoized and nudged; Error-prefixed result strings are not memoized and re-execute on retry because transient outcomes are possible
Duplicate allowlisted calls return cached results plus escalating static nudge text (level-1 on first repeat, level-2 on subsequent), with content byte-stable for provider prompt caching

The runaway guard wrapper remains the outermost guard and observes all tool-call signatures including memoized duplicates, maintaining distinct-ratio window math and abortion at the same pathological trip point
Non-allowlisted tools and write-unsafe tools (e.g. record_criterion_verdict) bypass memoization and always execute
Wrapper order is enforced: runaway guard → memoization layer → steering, with the guard's call_tool observing signatures before memo short-circuits
